parts.text: To what extent did your research and planning help you to be more creative?

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Evaluate one of your productions in relation to the concept of genre. 
Section B: Contemporary media issues
Answer one question from Section B.
You should refer to at least two different media and support your answer with reference to contemporary
examples.
Contemporary media regulation

text: Critically assess the arguments for and against greater regulation of the media. [50]
OR
How far do wider social issues impact upon media regulation? [50]
Global media
Critically analyse the ways in which institutions have developed global media. [50]
OR
What kinds of media audience behaviours are global? [50]
Media and collective identity
To what extent is human identity ‘mediated’? [50]
OR
Assess the implications of different media representations. [50]
Media in the online age
To what extent has convergence transformed the media? [50]
OR
Evaluate the relationship between online media and democracy. [50]
Postmodern media
Why might some media be described as ‘postmodern’? [50]
OR
How far do postmodern media challenge the relationship between text and audience? [50]
